When interfacing with a 16-bit memory, the FMC internally uses the ADDR[11:1] internal address lines to generate the external address. When interfacing with a 32-bit memory, the FMC internally uses.

notes: 1. When interfacing with a 16-bit memory, the FMC internally uses the ADDR[11:1] internal address lines to generate the external address. When interfacing with a 32-bit memory, the FMC internally uses ADDR[12:2] lines to generate the external address. Whatever the memory width, FMC_A[0] has to be connected to the SDRAM A[0].
2. The AutoPrecharge is not supported. However, FMC_A[10] must be connected to SDRAM A[0].
